title: connect_ws auth_header param type does not match AuthProvider::auth_header return type
description: ws/mod.rs connect_ws takes auth_header: Option<(&str, &str)> but AuthProvider::auth_header returns Option<(String, String)>. Callers must .as_deref() each tuple member to bridge the types. The doc comment does not mention this conversion. Either align the types (accept Option<(&str, &str)> and document the as_deref pattern) or accept Option<(String, String)> to match what the provider returns.
